summary: Verified z-index bug fix on MapMeet topbar. All topbar buttons (Utwórz wydarzenie, Zaloguj się, Załóż konto, view toggle, notifications bell) are clickable via Playwright natural actionability check WITHOUT force=true. Confirmed .mm-topbar z-index:1000 stacks above .mm-map z-index:1 (fixed, top:64px). No overlay intercepting clicks. Logged in flow (demo@mapmeet.pl) also works: create-event opens sidebar+banner, calendar toggle switches views, bell popover shows notifications.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css uses !important overrides on .mm-map height/width — acceptable to override Leaflet default sizing but consider scoping to Leaflet class instead.

TopBar.jsx: NotificationsBell rendered conditionally without data-testid at wrapper, but internal bell uses .mm-bell-btn — recommend adding data-testid='topbar-notifications-btn' directly on the bell trigger for stable test selectors (currently only class fallback works).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix z-index topbar confirmed. All clicks work without force=true. Note: data-testid='topbar-notifications-btn' not present on bell — falls back to .mm-bell-btn selector.
